control_units: absolute original position-actuator commands, rad;20ms hold128steps
rotation_decode: Rnext=Exp(world_delta_rotation) @ Rcur; raw saved R values are not projected
actual_boundary_rotation: F64 quaternion sandwich from saved raw qpos quaternion; no normalization or qpos repair; native snapshot R preserved separately
snapshot_velocity_inverse_scope: World omega is a source capture. When codec inverse reconstructs body omega, it is numerical derived arithmetic, not saved raw native-body bytes.
force_labels: Only snapshot last solver PRE scalar pads and explicit PRE clock. No unchosen per-step contact/force trajectories. H2 extrema stay only in branch-context table.
split_policy: No split assigned. Keep all46 rows in each source-boundary cohort together, including every H2 pair. Never random-row split branches/common boundaries. Cohorts are consecutive states of one actual failure prefix, not independent trajectories.
hidden_context: Warmstart/HISTORY and other integration/solver context not present in state58. Full-clone hash receipts are source-backed, not a state58 Markov certificate.
qualification: Simulator planning exploration and failed-hold coverage only; not real ego dynamics GT, policy performance, model accuracy, independent-trajectory generalization or Markov proof.
